name: Balia'mah Ruins
summary: Skullsplitter warriors hold the Balia'mah Ruins in northern Stranglethorn Vale. Across the river east of Grom'gol Base Camp, the old Gurubashi settlement's stone tiers crumble under the jungle.

sections.title: A Shattered Heritage
sections.body: Balia'mah's stone terraces recall the Gurubashi Empire, which once ruled much of the southern Eastern Kingdoms. When its ancient capital fell, Gurubashi lands split among warring factions. Now the Skullsplitter tribe holds the ruins. They defend them from beasts, ogres from the Mosh'Ogg mound, and outsiders crossing the river.

faq.q: Where are the Balia'mah Ruins located?
faq.answer: The Balia'mah Ruins lie in northern Stranglethorn Vale, east-southeast across the river from Grom'gol Base Camp and southwest of the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound.

faq.q: Who controls the ruins right now?
aliases: what mobs are at balia mah
faq.answer: The Skullsplitter tribe occupies the ruins and guards the ancient stone terraces.

faq.q: What is the history of Balia'mah?
faq.answer: The Gurubashi built the complex at the height of their empire. After the empire fell, the site decayed, then jungle growth and surviving troll tribes reclaimed it.

faq.q: Are the Skullsplitters at Balia'mah connected to other troll camps?
faq.answer: Yes. The Skullsplitter tribe keeps several camps and ruins across northern and central Stranglethorn Vale. There, it fights rival tribes such as the Bloodscalp for territory.

angles.text: As a Darkspear, these ancient stone terraces recall the proud Gurubashi civilization your ancestors shared. Factionalism later divided jungle troll society.
Across the river from Grom'gol Base Camp, hostile Skullsplitters at Balia'mah threaten Horde scouts and supply lines.
